{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|gr1= Remote Control

|descr= Returns true if UAV is connectable by AV terminal(s).

|s1= object [[isUAVConnectable]] [uav, checkAllItems]

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|p2= uav: [[Object]] or [[Array]]

|p3= checkAllItems: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to check all terminals in unit's inventory, [[false]] to only check assigned terminal.

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>private _canConnect = myUnit isUAVConnectable [myUav, true];</sqf>

|seealso= [[enableUAVConnectability]] [[disableUAVConnectability]]
}}
